title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant

High-Growth Manufacturing Business

Derbyshire (one day work from home after 3 month probation)

£30k - £32k + Full Study Support

8am - 5pm Monday - Thursday, 12pm finish on Fridays

Eaton Syalon is partnering with an investor-backed manufacturing organisation in Derbyshire that has achieved exceptional triple-digit growth over the past 36 months. As the business continues to scale, they are looking to appoint an Assistant Accountant to join their expanding finance team.

This is an outstanding opportunity to gain broad exposure across financial accounting, reporting, accounts receivable, operational finance, and month-end processes - all while receiving full study support and a clear pathway to becoming a fully qualified Accountant.

The Role

The successful candidate will support the finance function across a wide range of accounting and reporting activities, including:

Performing bank reconciliations and maintaining accurate cash book postings

Supporting the preparation of VAT returns and national statistics reporting

Assisting with maintaining the trial balance and updating supporting schedules

Preparing and posting journals including accruals, prepayments, and fixed asset depreciation

Producing and issuing sales invoices and credit notes

Maintaining the sales ledger and ensuring customer account accuracy

Providing weekly debtor cash updates and monitoring customer advances

Supporting month-end close processes including reconciliations and reporting

Preparing monthly reports including Other Debtors, GRNI, and cost centre review packs

Assisting with cost centre reviews through analysis preparation and participation in review meetings

Producing daily operational reports such as Hours vs Budget

Processing and reconciling intercompany recharges on a monthly basis

Ensuring intercompany balances are accurately recorded and fully supported

Assisting with year-end activities and responding to audit requests

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates who are:

AAT studying or qualified or someone in the early stages of CIMA/ACCA studies

Equipped with previous finance or accounts experience

Comfortable working with Excel and finance systems

Organised with strong attention to detail

Proactive, eager to learn, and keen to develop professionally

Looking for a long-term opportunity with progression into a qualified accounting role

What's on Offer

Clear progression route to becoming a qualified Accountant - full study support on offer

Exposure to a thriving manufacturing environment

Opportunity to join a business during an exciting phase of sustained growth

Supportive and collaborative finance team

Broad role offering genuine development and commercial exposure

Candidates currently working in an Accountancy Practice setting or those currently in industry will be considered for this role. It's a great opportunity to use as a first move into industry if you are 12-24 months into a career in practice and looking to make a move to industry. The role is equally suited to candidates already in an industry setting.

If you're looking for a role where you can build your accounting career within a dynamic, high-growth business, we'd love to hear from you.

Note - a full driving licence is required due to the location of the role.

title: Finance Administration Assistant
description:
Finance Administration Assistant

Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK Burnaston Fixed-Term Contract 6 months £26,000 £30,000 pro rata

Looking to start your career in finance with one of the world's best-known manufacturers?

Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK is looking for a Finance Administration Assistant to join the Cost Management team at its Burnaston manufacturing plant.

You don't need previous finance experience. If you're strong with numbers, confident using Excel and have a good eye for detail, Toyota will provide the training you need to build your career in finance.

About Toyota

Toyota's Burnaston plant is one of the UK's leading automotive manufacturing sites and has been part of the local community since the early 1990s.

The site is home to more than 2,000 team members and plays an important role in Toyota's European manufacturing operations, producing vehicles for markets around the world.

You'll be joining an established finance team within a highly structured manufacturing environment, gaining practical experience that goes well beyond basic administration.

The Role

As a Finance Administration Assistant, you'll support the Cost Management team across a variety of finance, accounting and cost-control activities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Finance Specialists with monthly accounting activities and cost tracking
- Preparing and checking financial documents, quotes, invoices and cost information
- Reconciling invoices against original quotes and investigating discrepancies
- Supporting cost recovery and claims processes
- Helping prepare monthly accounts and reporting packs
- Supporting journal preparation and posting
- Dealing with cost and finance queries from across the business
- Supporting purchasing activities, including raising and approving orders
- Assisting with stocktake preparation
- Maintaining accurate records and Excel spreadsheets
- Working with engineers, finance specialists and other teams to resolve queries
- Supporting project-specific cost tracking and reporting

The role will give you exposure to different areas of finance, including accounting, cost management, reconciliation, cost recovery, purchasing and project finance.

What we're looking for

This is an entry-level opportunity, so previous finance experience isn't essential. Toyota will provide job-specific training.

We're looking for someone with:
- A-levels including Maths, ideally grade A or B
- Strong working knowledge of Excel
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to collect, organise and manage data accurately
- Good problem-solving skills
- A hands-on attitude and willingness to learn
- Strong communication skills
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Drive, enthusiasm and a flexible approach to changing priorities

A full UK driving licence may also be required depending on the area of the Cost Management team you support.

Why Toyota?

This isn't simply an administration role.

It's an opportunity to start building a career in finance inside a world-leading automotive manufacturer, working alongside experienced Finance Specialists and gaining hands-on exposure to real accounting and cost-management processes.

You'll receive training, develop your Excel and financial skills and gain experience across multiple areas of the finance function.

If you've got a strong Maths background, enjoy working with numbers and want to get your foot in the door with Toyota, we'd like to hear from you.

ATA is committed to creating a diverse workforce and is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of age, disability, gender, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation

title: Receptionist
description: Jessop Medical Practice is seeking to recruit a highly motivated, enthusiastic professional receptionist to join our practice team. We are a large friendly training practice with modern purpose built premises. The successful applicant will have a good standard of general education, be computer literate, organised and with excellent communication skills. Previous experience is preferred. The position is part time, Monday to Friday comprising of 7.30am starts and 6.30pm finishes. There is also a requirement to cover extended hours on a rota basis from 6.30pm-8pm on a Monday evening. The receptionist is an important member of the Practice team. The purpose of the job is to provide a point of contact for patients, and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors and other medical and non-medical staff. The ability to communicate confidently and effectively with patients, doctors, colleagues and other agencies is therefore vital. JOB DESCRIPTION JOB TITLE: RECEPTIONIST ACCOUNTABLE TO: PRACTICE MANAGER & PARTNERS REPORTING TO: PRACTICE MANAGER & ASSISTANT MANAGER HOURS: PART TIME Job Summary: Job Responsibilities: At the start of the day, open up the surgery and prepare for morning surgery. Pass any messages on as necessary. Ensure the security of the premises before leaving. Arrange patient appointment times, and record patient arrivals on the Practice computer system. Receive and note messages by telephone, record requests for home visits and other services provided by the Practice. Ensure messages are appropriately passed via the SystmOne appointment system to the relevant person. Answer patient queries both in person and over the telephone, including results of investigations, hospital appointments and give advice on administrative matters. Refer to other members of the Practice Team where appropriate. Ensure accurate and detailed information is given when accepting new patients, inform them of the way the Practice functions and issue them with a Practice Leaflet. Prepare repeat prescriptions on computer in readiness for the doctors authorisation and signature. Review need for follow-up according to Practice protocols and action as needed. Organise prescriptions for collection or post. Provide assistance in separately designated hours with prescription related queries, where possible actioning repeats in line with agreed protocols, ensuring patients are called for review as necessary. Check the action lists from doctors concerning pathology results and communicate these to patients by phone or letter. Ensure the Task list is actioned in a timely and effective manner. Liaise effectively with doctors, nurses and other Practice staff including attached professional staff such as midwives, district nurses and health visitors, other external agencies such as the hospitals, chemists, social services, to ensure relevant information is passed on appropriately. In collaboration with your reception supervisor, ensure responsibility to provide reception cover when a team member is on annual leave or to cover sickness. Additional Duties: Other administrative duties that may be required to assist with the smooth running of the surgery. Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, Practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the Practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & Safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the Practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Reporting potential risks identified Equality and Diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the Practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Attending & contributing to practice meetings Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the Practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the Implementation of Services: The post-holder will: Apply Practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work
